questions.q: What does the Dependency View actually show?
options: A separate, independently calculated dataset about CI risk
A visual graph of a CI's upstream and downstream relationships, read directly from existing cmdb_rel_ci records
A list of CIs with no relationships recorded at all
A forecast of which CIs are likely to need replacement
questions.explain: The Dependency View doesn't calculate anything new — it's a graphical read of the same relationship data already stored on cmdb_rel_ci.

questions.q: What happens in the Dependency View if the underlying cmdb_rel_ci relationships for a CI are missing or wrong?
options: The Dependency View automatically corrects them using Discovery
The Dependency View faithfully displays that same missing or wrong picture, since it isn't a separate source of truth
The CI is automatically removed from the CMDB
The platform blocks the Dependency View from opening
questions.explain: Because the Dependency View is just a visual read of existing data, bad or missing relationship data shows up as a bad or missing graph.

questions.q: What is the real cost of manual relationship documentation, as described in this lesson?
options: It requires separate licensing in every ServiceNow edition
It cannot be used for any relationship type pair
Ongoing upkeep — a human has to remember to update relationship records every time the environment changes, or the data goes stale
It cannot be visualized in the Dependency View
questions.explain: Manual documentation is simple to set up, but in a large, fast-changing environment the upkeep burden is exactly where it tends to drift out of date.

questions.q: How does Service Mapping actually build its relationship data, as opposed to manual documentation?
options: It asks the CI's owner to fill out a longer form
It traces real network traffic and process-level connections between components to discover relationships automatically
It copies relationships from a different ServiceNow instance
It generates relationships randomly and asks an admin to approve them
questions.explain: Service Mapping identifies actual connections between running components and builds the corresponding cmdb_rel_ci records from what it genuinely finds.

questions.q: Per this lesson, what's the realistic conclusion about choosing between manual documentation and Service Mapping?
options: Service Mapping should always replace manual documentation everywhere, with no exceptions
Manual documentation should always be preferred since it requires no licensing
Most mature instances use both — Service Mapping for complex, fast-changing services, and manual documentation for simpler, slower-changing relationships
Neither approach is ever used in a real ServiceNow instance
questions.explain: The tradeoff is real: automated discovery earns its investment for complex services, while manual documentation remains adequate for simpler, stable ones.
